_comment: GENERIC EXAMPLE — copy this file to listings.json and replace the values with your own monitored Google Business Profile listings. The scraper works for any chain/business: a 'branch' is a location of your chain, and each branch lists competitor businesses to monitor. The dashboard auto-derives brand/location words for the word cloud from these names, and charts strip the chain prefix (everything before the last ' - ') automatically.
_guide: branch_id   : short unique slug for a location of YOUR chain, e.g. 'myco-downtown'.
branch_name : human-readable branch name, e.g. 'My Company - Downtown'. The location part (after the last ' - ') is what charts show.
competitors : the Google Business Profile listings you want to watch in that area.
name        : display name of the competitor.
place_id    : Google Maps place ID (starts with ChIJ). Required for live scraping. Get it from the Maps URL: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ...
gmaps_url   : fallback URL. Can be a mock value; live mode builds the real URL from place_id. In fixtures mode the mock URL is used.
